Why IT Leaders Choose Total Assure
Federal-Grade Protection Without Federal-Level Complexity
You get security protocols proven in the most demanding environments, adapted specifically for SMB operations. No bureaucracy, no complexity, just rigorous protection that works for your business.
U.S.-Based, In-House SOC Team (Not Offshore, Not Outsourced)
When a threat is detected at 2 AM, you get a U.S.-based analyst who understands your business, your compliance requirements, and can communicate clearly when seconds matter. No language barriers, no time zone delays, no outsourced call centers.
Direct Access to Leadership, Not Just a Ticket Queue
Led by CEO Bruce Arvand and CIO Jack Byrne, you get direct access to our leadership team, not just a ticketing system. Your dedicated account team knows your business, your environment, and your goals. When you call, you talk to people who actually know who you are.
Enterprise-Grade Technology Stack
Built on Splunk's SIEM platform, integrated SentinelOne EDR, and Avanan email security. You get Fortune 500-level tools without the Fortune 500 price tag or complexity.
Flat-Rate Pricing (No Per-User Surprises)
One predictable monthly rate, no per-user fees that explode as you grow, no hidden charges, no surprise invoices. You know exactly what you'll pay, making budgeting simple and scaling affordable.

Frequently Asked Questions
Q1: We already have security tools. Do we need to replace everything?
Not at all. We integrate with your existing infrastructure, including firewalls, cloud platforms, and productivity tools. Our complimentary assessment will help you optimize your current investments and pinpoint any areas for improvement. We enhance what you have, not replace it.
Q2: How is this different from our current IT provider's security?
Most IT providers focus on keeping systems running, while security is often an add-on. We're security specialists with a dedicated 24/7 SOC team, enterprise-grade tools (Splunk, SentinelOne), and proactive threat hunting. Think of us as your dedicated security team working alongside your IT provider.
Q3: What's the actual time commitment from our team?
Minimal. Initial onboarding requires a few hours for discovery and planning. After that, we handle the day-to-day monitoring and response. You'll get regular reports and alerts when action is needed, but we manage the heavy lifting. Most clients spend less than X hours per month on security after onboarding.
Q4: Can we scale up or down as our business changes?
Absolutely. Our flat-rate pricing model is designed to scale with you. As you add employees or infrastructure, we adjust coverage accordingly. No surprise charges, no penalties for growth.
